__comment_purpose: Read by build_layered_vti_model.py to generate a 3-D case and run_forward.ps1. Relative output paths are resolved against this JSON file. Rebuild the case after changing the configuration. Fields beginning with __comment_ are documentation only.
__comment_storage_dtype: Material-array storage precision: float32 or float64. This is independent of forward.dtype, which controls propagation precision.
__comment_mat_compression: Enable compression when writing MAT files. false avoids compression work but produces larger files.

grid.__comment_dimensions: Numbers of grid points along x, y, and z. The builder requires each dimension to be at least 11 and larger than forward.order. MAT arrays use [z,x,y]; internal solver arrays use [z,y,x].
grid.__comment_spacing: Grid spacing dx/dy/dz in metres. Each value must be positive.

__comment_layers: Layers must cover z=0 through nz without gaps or overlaps. Each layer uses the half-open zero-based interval [z_start,z_end). rho is in kg/m^3 and all stiffness coefficients are in Pa.

layers.__comment_layer: name/color affect plotting. z_start is inclusive and z_end exclusive. rho is density; C11, C13, C33, C44, and C66 are the five independent VTI stiffnesses.
layers.name: Layer 1

layers.__comment_layer: name/color affect plotting. z_start is inclusive and z_end exclusive. rho is density; C11, C13, C33, C44, and C66 are the five independent VTI stiffnesses.
layers.name: Layer 2

layers.__comment_layer: name/color affect plotting. z_start is inclusive and z_end exclusive. rho is density; C11, C13, C33, C44, and C66 are the five independent VTI stiffnesses.
layers.name: Layer 3

pml.__comment_enabled: false writes zero damping arrays and uses nAB=0 in the generated case.
pml.__comment_thickness: PML thickness in grid cells. When enabled, require 2*nAB < min(nx,ny,nz).
pml.__comment_boundary_type: topABC damps all six sides. The builder also accepts topFS, which omits upper-z damping; the current solver does not add an explicit traction-free surface update.
pml.__comment_reflection: Target reflection coefficient for damping design; must be in (0,1). It is not a measured reflection guarantee.
pml.__comment_profile: Positive power of the damping profile; 2.0 gives a quadratic increase into the absorbing layer.

source.__comment_position: Zero-based [x,y,z] grid indices. Keep the source inside the active stencil region, at least order/2 cells from each outer boundary.
source.__comment_sampling: total_time and dt are in seconds. The builder creates N=floor(total_time/dt+0.5)+1 samples; the solver advances N-3 steps. Choose dt for a stable model/grid/order combination; the reported Courant indicator is diagnostic only.
source.__comment_wavelet: Ricker central frequency f0 in hertz and centre delay t0 in seconds. f0 must be positive and t0 non-negative.
source.__comment_amplitude: Wavelet amplitude multiplier. The moment-tensor source pattern is selected by forward.source_kind.

receivers.__comment_layout: axis_line generates an axis-aligned line; explicit instead requires points_xyz=[[x,y,z],...]. All coordinates are zero-based grid indices. Receivers should lie inside the active stencil region.
receivers.__comment_axis: Axis varied by axis_line: x, y, or z.
receivers.__comment_range: Inclusive start/stop indices with a positive step. Current values produce 21 receivers along x.
receivers.__comment_fixed_coordinates: The two coordinates perpendicular to axis remain fixed. The coordinate matching axis is ignored when constructing points.

plot.__comment_enabled: Generate layer/model figures while building the case. Forward wavefield plots are controlled separately by main.py options.
plot.__comment_style: reference uses normal depth sorting and translucent occlusion; wireframe overlays visible edges and markers.
plot.__comment_modes: Select combined, model, and/or parameters without duplicates. Each selected view needs a distinct filename with an extension and no directory components.
plot.__comment_filenames: filename is the combined view; model_filename is geometry only; parameters_filename is the material-parameter view.
plot.__comment_resolution: Image resolution in dots per inch. Large dpi values increase rendering cost and file size.
plot.__comment_figure_size: Base figure width and height in inches; the selected view determines the final layout.
plot.__comment_view_angles: 3-D camera elevation and azimuth in degrees.
plot.__comment_opacity: Layer opacity in (0,1]; 1 is fully opaque.
plot.__comment_outlines: Matplotlib color for the edges; outline_width and interface_width set line widths in points.
plot.__comment_markers: Toggle source, receiver, and coordinate-axis markers independently.
plot.__comment_axis_arrows: Coordinate-arrow length relative to the model span along its own axis; must be in (0,0.5].

forward.__comment_interpreter: Interpreter path written into run_forward.ps1. Update this machine-specific path to your CUDA/Triton environment before building.
forward.__comment_source_kind: dc1 or dc2 selects a predefined double-couple tensor; both runs the two sources separately.
forward.__comment_spatial_order: The 3-D solver supports 4, 6, 8, and 10. The builder also accepts 2, but the current solver coefficient routine rejects it. A halo of order/2 cells is excluded from updates.
forward.__comment_compute_dtype: Propagation precision: fp32 or fp64. fp64 requires twice the field storage; performance depends on the GPU.
forward.__comment_triton_block: Elements per Triton program instance. The supplied value is 256; use a Triton-compatible block size when tuning performance.
forward.__comment_snapshot: -1 selects the last active step N-3; otherwise choose [1,N-3]. Saved XY/XZ/YZ planes pass through the source. Snapshot time follows (snapshot_step-1)*dt.
forward.__comment_outputs: Directory for forward results, relative to the case directory in run_forward.ps1. Receiver sampling is fixed at record_stride=1.
forward.__comment_prefix: Prefix for MAT/NPZ results, JSON metadata, and wavefield figures.
